# wsb

> wsb is a free, open-source (MIT) plugin for OpenCode. When an OpenCode session hits a subscription usage limit (Claude Max, ChatGPT/Codex or OpenCode Go), wsb waits until the limit resets and OpenCode retries the same turn with the same model. Nobody has to type "continue".

## Install

Run once in a terminal (OpenCode 2.3 or newer):

```sh
opencode plugin add git+https://github.com/tsu-ld/wsb.git#production
```

Or paste this into a coding agent:

> Install the wsb plugin for my OpenCode user: run `opencode plugin add git+https://github.com/tsu-ld/wsb.git#production` and check that it loads.

To uninstall, remove the wsb entry from `plugins` in the OpenCode config.

## How it works

1. The provider refuses a request because the subscription usage limit is reached.
2. wsb reads the exact reset time for that account and model: from the error itself, from the provider's usage endpoint (ChatGPT, OpenCode Go) or from the local Meridian proxy used by opencode-with-claude (Claude Max).
3. It tells OpenCode's own retry to wait until that time. If OpenCode restarts in between, the deadline is kept and the turn resumes on time.
4. At the reset, OpenCode retries the same turn. No new session, no provider switch, no polling the model.

If the reset time is unknown, wsb leaves OpenCode's normal retry behaviour alone. A manual prompt or an interrupt always wins.

## Supported subscriptions

- Claude Max, through opencode-with-claude (Meridian proxy)
- ChatGPT / Codex, signed in with OAuth
- OpenCode Go (five-hour, weekly and monthly limits)

Metered OpenAI and Anthropic API keys are not supported.

## FAQ

- Does it bypass usage limits? No. It waits for the reset the provider reports.
- Does it spend extra quota? No. It never sends a request before the reset.
- Does it work with OpenCode 1.x? No, it targets OpenCode 2.3+.
